rv.q: Indeed, there may be no better alternative to the traditional holiday fare about to be filling L.A. theaters than this farcical, satirical gem.
I literally can't remember the last time I laughed so much at the theater.
Casey Stangl directs with a sure feel for comic timing.

Excellent character work means there are laughs to be had in this West Coast Premiere, directed by Casey Stangl, but an inconsistent tone and puzzling staging make for an ultimately arduous experience.

“Nacho Ate Spiderman" is a laugh-out-loud comedy from multi-award-winning playwright Michelle Kholos Brooks ( H*tler’s Tasters, Hostage, Kalamazoo ) whose work has been staged both nationally and internationally.

cn.t: Critics largely praise "Nacho Ate Spiderman" for its sharp comedy and strong character work, though some find it uneven. Brooks' witty script earns consistent laughs while skewering suburban hypocrisy.
